summary.text: Tibi Czentye is the Republican candidate for South Carolina House of Representatives District 41 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democratic incumbent Annie McDaniel.
He previously sought the Republican nomination for South Carolina State Senate District 17 in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Tibi Czentye ran in the Republican primary for South Carolina State Senate District 17 on June 11, 2024.
He received 16.4% of the vote (1,106 votes), finishing third behind Everett Stubbs and Tripp McCoy.
